goal: Ensure wallet database write and erase failures are handled rather than silently ignored
Prevents in-memory state and on-disk records from diverging, avoiding wallet corruption or data loss
agreement: Unaddressed objection: reporting corruption on a full disk or permission issue misguides users (vicjuma)
Raised multiple edge cases around write failure handling and backups, answered by author (jeanpablojp)
Concept support for enforcing consistency between in-memory state and database writes (rkrux, l0rinc)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it prevents silent database write failures from causing desynchronization and data loss
Resolves systematic consistency and corruption risks across the wallet storage layer
